description: Header file defining FileSystemMonitor classes for Linux and Windows, implementing file system change monitoring with callback registration, using inotify on Linux and ReadDirectoryChangesW on Windows.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor
classes.description: Main class for monitoring file system changes, with platform-specific implementations for Linux and Windows.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback objects to be notified of file system updates.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Context
classes.description: Internal class for Windows to handle directory change notifications asynchronously.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Dispatcher
classes.description: Thread class for processing file system events on Windows.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specific file or directory.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a callback for a specific file or directory.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the monitor is valid/initialized.

methods.name: Trigger
methods.description: Triggers the event to wake the processing thread (Windows).
